data.summary: Vauban is a highly versatile Warframe that excels in both offensive and supportive roles. His strong damage output from Photon Strike and crowd control from Minelayer and Bastille make him a valuable asset in various combat scenarios. However, his lack of stealth capabilities limits his effectiveness in stealth-based roles.
